title: Ei Ohitsuji's Ochibure Zeus to Dorei no Ko Manga Changes Publisher
content:
The November issue of Asahi Shimbun Publications ' Nemuki+ magazine announced on Tuesday that Ei Ohitsuji 's Ochibure Zeus to Dorei no Ko ( Fallen Zeus and the Slave Boy ) manga will move to Ichijinsha 's Zero-Sum Online manga website in spring next year. Additionally, sales of the manga's digital version will halt on October 31, but purchased volumes will remain available even after distribution ends.

Ohitsuji also made the announcement on their X/Twitter account and added that the series will resume on Zero-Sum Online starting from the first chapter, with added revisions and corrections. Ohitsuji noted that the first two chapters of the manga will differ significantly from the current versions after revisions. Ohitsuji also assured readers that despite the changes, additions, and revisions, the manga's latest fifth compiled book volume will seamlessly connect with the upcoming sixth volume that Ichijinsha will publish.

Ohitsuji launched the manga in Nemuki+ in February 2022. Asahi Shimbun Publications published the manga's first volume in 2023, and the fifth volume in March 2025. The first part of the manga's story ended with the "Egypt Arc" in December 2025. With the end of the manga's first part, Ohitsuji also announced the manga's hiatus. Ohitsuji stated then that the hiatus is to review and adjust production setup for the manga, and also to recover their health.

Ohitsuji's Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court manga , the adaptation of Satsuki Nakamura 's light novel series of the same title, launched in Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine, simultaneously with the novels in December 2020. Ichijinsha published the manga's 11th volume on September 30. Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga and released its ninth volume on August 4.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 New Poster Visual and Trailer Introduce More Characters
content:
CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 has revealed a new poster key visual and trailer ahead of the show’s October 20, 2026 release. Studio TRIGGER is back to animate, with Netflix set to exclusively stream the series. We recently spoke with the show’s writer and producer Bartosz Sztybor , who told us why they chose the studio and shared insights into the production.

The new anime is a new 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , earlier described as “a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge.” It is directed by Kai Ikarashi, who directed Episode 6 of the original anime titled “Girl on Fire.” Ichigo Kanno is the character designer, while screenplay will be handled by Masahiko Otsuka. Bartosz Sztybor is also back as showrunner, story writer, and producer. The anime was voted as the most anticipated Fall 2026 anime by Anime Corner’s followers.

You can see the new visual below.

Four of the main characters and their Japanese/English voice cast were previously revealed. They include:

• Weak Kingsley: Once known as “King,” a veteran edgerunner at the top of his game, Weak now lives in the shadow of his former glory.

• D: A Snake Nation netrunner with sharp technical skills and a sharper hunger for revenge, D hunts the killer who wiped out his clan.

• Roman Carax: A young cinephile searching for real stories. In a city that abandoned cinema for neurodance. Obsessed with documenting the truth, he closely follows the lives of other people.

• Talia Yang: Raised in the corpo towers, but hardened by the trials of Maelström, Talia is fiercely independent, steeped in hyperviolent culture, and obsessed with her gang’s chrome.

Also watch the new trailer:

CD PROJEKT RED (or CDPR) is the company behind the Cyberpunk 2077 video game. Studio TRIGGER also animated the first CYBERPUNK: EDGE RUNNERS anime series, which was released in September 2022 and also had a total of 10 episodes. The franchise launched a prequel manga focused on Rebecca and Pilar in December 2024.

The first anime was voted as the Best New Anime of the year in our yearly awards for that year, as well as the Best Original Anime. Netflix is streaming the show , describing its story: The series tells a standalone, 10-episode story about a street kid trying to survive in Night City — a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future. Having everything to lose, he stays alive by becoming an edgerunner — a mercenary outlaw also known as a cyberpunk.

title: Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Expands Cast Ahead of Netflix Release
content:
Blue Eye Samurai is now in the works on coming back to Netflix with Season 2 of its animated series run next year, and has now revealed more of the new faces joining the cast for its new season. Blue Eye Samurai has been one of the most notable new releases on Netflix in the last few years. The anime inspired series introduced fans to a samurai on the quest for revenge, and the next season is taking her to London for the next phase in her journey .

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 will be introducing some new faces to the cast not only in this new region, but for the next phase of the other characters’ stories across Japan. Netflix has recently revealed three of the new cast members making their debuts along with the first look at their respective designs , but their role in the upcoming season is still a mystery about what kind of story they will be involved with in the new episodes. You can get the full breakdown below.

Blue Eye Samurai Reveals New Cast Additions for Season 2

As revealed by Netflix, the newest names joining Blue Eye Samurai for Season 2 include Jonathan Pryce as Old Violet, Joel Kim Booster as Priest Ando, and Sherry Cola as Kuma. They’ll be joining alongside currently confirmed members of the returning cast from the first season such as Maya Erksine as Mizu, Kenneth Branagh as Abijah Fowler and more. As the new season continues to come together, it won’t be too much longer before we get to see much more of it in action as it will be making its return to Netflix early next year.

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 is currently scheduled to make its release worldwide with Netflix sometime in January 2027, but no concrete release date has yet to be announced as of this time. But that’s not all that’s planned for the future of the franchise as it has also been revealed that there’s also a third season of the series in the works as well . But this third season will actually be the final one bringing Mizu’s story to its ultimate conclusion. There’s quite a lot more to look forward to now that it’s been confirmed Netflix will let this story get to its ending.

What to Know for Blue Eye Samurai Season 2

Blue Eye Samurai series creators Amber Noizumi and Michael Green are returning for the new season with animation production from Blue Spirit, and the duo is all in support of its comparisons to anime. As Green previously told ComicBook , “We’re anime fans too, and we knew what we were doing wasn’t anime, but we were hoping the anime fans would find it and embrace it as something as a distant cousin, but familiar,” the creator stated.” So it’s been wonderful. I mean, anime fans are so passionate. They love it…like the most rabid sports fan doesn’t love their team like anime fans love anime.”

Blue Eye Samurai has been a big success for Netflix thus far with some notable Emmy awards wins under its belt, and it’s likely that this second season will be continuing that hot streak if the earliest reactions to the season are any indication . What are you hoping to see from these new characters in Blue Eye Samurai Season 2? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Acorn Media Confirms Upcoming UK Blu-rays of My Gift Lvl 9999 and Sword of the Demon Hunter
content:
My Gift Lvl 9999 Unlimited Gacha was made by J.C. Staff in 2025 and is about a powerful Level 999 Overlord. The story is described on Amazon as follows:

" After being recruited to join the Concord of Tribes, a group consisting of one each of the other eight races, Light was shocked when they suddenly attempted to kill him! Miraculously managing to escape and survive in the deepest depths of a dungeon. Light is astonished to learn that he's much more powerful than anyone imagined and his thoughts quickly turn to revenge. It won't be easy, and it may take years, but with the aid of his newly summoned Ever-Seeking Maid and his increased abilities, he'll cut a bloody path through their dead and dying bodies!"

"When Jinta defeats a powerful demon, he gains its power but also a terrible prophecy, one that will shatter his adopted family and leave him wandering the lands in search of resolution. The shrine maiden he'd sworn to protect is dead and her killer missing, he changes his name and travels Japan in search of his missing sister and the foretold destiny he dreads but must seek. How many miles must he journey? How many years will it take? As the decades pass he becomes a legend, helping those in need along the way as he marches toward his fate in Sword of the Demon Hunter !"

title: Hyderabad Anime India Convention Hosts Bleach Director Noriyuki Abe as Guest on November 14-15
content:
The convention will host the next Kolkata event on February 27-28.

Naruto director Hayato Date ( Naruto Shippūden , Flame of Recca ) attended the Mumbai 2026 event as a guest. Voice actor Akari Yura ( The Beginning After The End , Catch Me at the Ballpark! ) performed as a musical act at the convention's concert, and Luna Goami ( Sparks of Tomorrow ) and Mofmofmo performed at the concert. ASCA ( Sword Art Online: Alicization , Edens Zero ) also performed at the event. Producer Ryōta Hasegawa ( Dr. Stone , Sakamoto Days ) attended the event as a guest. The event hosted meet and greets for all four musical artists as well as with Ryōta Hasegawa . Kadokawa participated in a "fireside chat" in the event's Animation & More Summit, as did ' Sony YAY!'

Anime India hosted voice actor Kazuhiko Inoue ( Naruto , Parasyte -the maxim- , 2025 Ranma ½ ) as a guest at its event in Delhi. Delhi Anime India took place at Yashobhoomi Convention Centre on June 6 and June 7. YURiKA ( Little Witch Academia , Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department ) performed at the event as well.

Anime India hosted its Kolkata event at Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan on February 14 and February 15. The event featured a panel and a workshop by director Susumu Mitsunaka ( Haikyu!! director, Weathering With You key animator).

Anime India's previous Mumbai event took place in 2025 from August 22 through August 24 at NESCO BEC in Mumbai. Director Tetsuro Araki attended the event as the "flagship guest." Voice actor Tsunko ( D4DJ First Mix , D4DJ All Mix ), president of Avex Pictures ' Hideo Katsumata , and DJ Tōko Nakamura also attended the event as guests. Hikari Dobashi attended the event as an exhibitor representing TV Tokyo .

title: AFA Singapore Adds Kagurabachi Anime as Featured Anime
content:
Shochiku , CyberAgent , and the Anime Festival Asia convention announced on Monday that the "world tour" television anime of Takeru Hokazono 's Kagurabachi manga will enter its "third part" by being featured as a part of the AFA Singapore convention. The anime will feature in the convention on November 29 with a talk event.

The AFA Singapore convention will take place at the Suntec Singapore International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Singapore on November 27 to 29.

Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service are releasing the Kagurabachi manga digitally in English. MANGA Plus describes the story:

Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge. Epic sword battle action!

The anime stars:

• Taihi Kimura as Chihiro Rokuhira

• Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige Rokuhira

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Togo Shiba

• Miku Itō as Hinao

• Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi

Tetsuya Takeuchi ( From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated! director; key animator for Naruto and Naruto Shippūden ) is directing the anime at Cypic ( The World Is Dancing ). Keigo Sasaki (character designer for Blue Exorcist , Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray ) is designing the characters. Shochiku and CyberAgent are on the production committee .

The anime will premiere in April 2027, and will stream that month worldwide excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea. The "world tour" event for the anime began this past July at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, Japan Expo Paris in Paris, ANImagic in Mannheim, Germany, and in August at Anime NYC in New York. The event is showing the first 20 minutes of the first episode, and will end in Japan in spring 2027 where the full first episode will be screened.

title: Phoenix Gramedia Licenses Silent Hill f Novel
content:
Kadokawa and Gramedia's Phoenix Gramedia company announced on Tuesday that it has licensed Shiro Kuro 's novelization of Silent Hill f , the recent spinoff game for the Silent Hill franchise , and will release it in Indonesia "soon."

The novelization originally released in Japan in October 2025.

The Silent Hill f game launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on September 25, 2025. The game had exceeded 1 million units in cumulative worldwide shipments, as of September 26. The cumulative total includes physical copies and digital downloads of the game.

Ryukishi07 ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) wrote the story, and kera designed the creatures and characters. Motoi Okamoto produced the game, and Neobards Entertainment ( Resident Evil Re:Verse ) developed the game.

Ame Gōkin launched a manga adaptation with a new ending from Ryukishi07 on Kadokawa 's Young Ace Up manga website on April 22.

Silent Hill f is also inspiring a new manga spinoff focused on the Fox Mask character in the Weekly Famitsu magazine in late 2026. The story is supervised by the game's original writer Ryukishi07 and Konami . The manga will have two separate parts, with the first part depicting the origin story of Fox Mask. New artist Ayato will draw the manga.
author: ANN

Ryukishi07 ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) wrote the story, and kera designed the creatures and characters. Motoi Okamoto produced the game, and Neobards Entertainment ( Resident Evil Re:Verse ) developed the game.
Ame Gōkin launched a manga adaptation with a new ending from Ryukishi07 on Kadokawa 's Young Ace Up manga website on April 22.

Silent Hill f is also inspiring a new manga spinoff focused on the Fox Mask character in the Weekly Famitsu magazine in late 2026. The story is supervised by the game's original writer Ryukishi07 and Konami . The manga will have two separate parts, with the first part depicting the origin story of Fox Mask. New artist Ayato will draw the manga.

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film Opens in Singapore on October 31
content:
Aniplus Asia announced on Tuesday that it will open Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, in Singapore on October 31.

Yukihiro Miyamoto ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica , Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) directed the film.

The returning cast includes:

• Aoi Yūki as Madoka Kaname

• Chiwa Saitō as Homura Akemi

• Kaori Mizuhashi as Mami Tomoe

• Eri Kitamura as Sayaka Miki

• Ai Nonaka as Kyōko Sakura

• Kana Asumi as Nagisa Momoe

• Emiri Katō as Kyubey

Shion Wakayama voices the new magical girl Shichōka, and Tomoyo Kurosawa voices Selma Therese. Maaya Sakamoto plays the unnamed upperclassman, or Wasu, who looks like Homura but nobody knows her true name or identity.

The anime film features a returning staff from the original anime series and films, including original creators Magica Quartet , chief director Akiyuki Simbo , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , original character designer Ume Aoki , animation character designer Junichirō Taniguchi , composer Yuki Kajiura , alternate space designer Gekidan Inu Curry , and animation studio SHAFT .

The new and returning staff members are:

• Chief Animation Directors: Junichirō Taniguchi, Hiroki Yamamura

• storyboard/Visual Concept Design: Tomohiro Furukawa (new)

• Visual Concept Design: Kazuki Kawada

• Color Key Artist: Jin Hibino

• Art: Ken Naitō (returnng), Shūichi Kusamori (new)

• Art Setting: Morihito Ōhara

• Compositing Director of Photography: Takayuki Aizu

• Editing: Rie Matsubara

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

Yuki Kajiura 's solo project FictionJunction perform the theme song "Kanata."

SHAFT first hinted at a new work in the franchise through a concept movie in 2015, but the film was only announced in April 2021.

The film has suffered numerous previous delays, the most recent of which happened in January due to production circumstances, delaying the movie from a planned opening in February. Prior to this most recent delay, the film was previously slated to open in Japan in winter 2024, but was delayed in August 2024 to winter 2025, before the delay to February 2026.

The television edition of the Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings and Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal compilation films began airing in October 2025.

The original 12-episode Puella Magi Madoka Magica television anime premiered in January 2011. The Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings and Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal compilation films opened in Japan in October 2012, and then the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion sequel film opened in October 2013.

A television anime adaptation of the Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story smartphone game premiered in January 2020. The anime's second season premiered in July 2021. The third and final season debuted in April 2022.

The smartphone game launched for iOS and Android devices in Japan in August 2017, and was free to play with optional in-game purchases. The English version launched in the United States and Canada in June 2019. The English version of the game ended service in September 2020, and the Japanese version ended service in July 2024.

The Puella Magi Madoka Magica : Magia Exedra smartphone game launched in March 2025, following a delay from 2024 for the staff to "ensure even higher quality in the final game." The game got a version for PC via Steam in July 2025.
author: ANN
